title: Persistently disclose refeeding limitations
description: Display understandable non-color-only text throughout relevant sheet-instance and preparation screens stating that the application cannot determine mechanical refeeding safety.
acceptanceCriteria: The disclaimer is visible during instance editing, selection, preview/planning, reuse confirmation, and preparation review
Text explicitly says the application cannot determine whether a partially used sheet is mechanically safe to refeed
Warnings distinguish recorded used positions from physical inspection and safety
The disclosure is programmatically associated where action is required and remains understandable without color or icon

steps.details: Create one versioned refeeding-limitation disclosure string/model for all relevant surfaces to prevent claim drift.
Render the disclosure in management, selection, preview, confirmation, and preparation details without hiding it behind optional help.
Use text plus appropriate semantic warning/status relationships and ensure confirmation controls reference the disclosure.
Add browser assertions for every surface, keyboard reading order, non-color text, and prohibited safe-refeeding claim absence.

technicalNotes: Maximum execution scope is ten minutes; reuse one canonical disclosure component across existing surfaces.
The warning must remain present after confirmation; acknowledgement does not make the condition safe.
Avoid shortened copy that could imply a feed guarantee.
